name: Lighthouse Buff Alasdair

intro.text: Dunnet Head lighthouse, 1831, Robert Stevenson. The light is 105 metres above the sea and windows at the top have been broken by stones flung up in storms. Battle?

after: Four generations of the Stevenson family built the lighthouses of Scotland. Robert Louis Stevenson was meant to join the business. He wrote Treasure Island instead. His dad was furious.
